messages:
emma: Heads up saw a customer hit a route throttle caused by provisional overcount after a streaming retry + toolcall truncate. filing here.
dev: sequence?
emma: client streamed prefix (credited), toolcall truncated suffix, reconnect resumed and sampler logged the tool output inline again. aggregator added stream+toolcall, ledger later deduped by toolcall_id. provisional spiked and quota tripped.
rachel: logs clipped:
```
[10:11:01.100] sample sess=xyz prefix=50 toolcall=0 prov_tokens=50
[10:11:01.210] toolcall id=tc-101 tokens=20 credited_toolcall=true
[10:11:01.305] reconnect resume-offset=50
[10:11:01.310] sample sess=xyz resumed_stream_includes_tool_output tokens=20 prov_tokens=20
[10:11:32.500] ledger commit sess=xyz confirmed_stream=50 confirmed_toolcall=20 dedupe_toolcall=true adjustment=-20
```

dev: aggregator should dedupe by toolcall_id for provisional. if sampler tags toolcall_id we can ignore duplicates immediately.
emma: ops want quick mitigation: 1) clamp per-session provisional used for quota to not exceed session_threshold * 1.2; 2) show tooltip in console explaining provisional is an estimate.
ops-bot: ticket BI-0001 created for CS blurb; ENG-0002 created for aggregator dedupe.
neil: long-term: sampler -> aggregator wire includes toolcall_id and sample_epoch; aggregator keeps epoch buffers and merges only when stable. ledger emits a dedupe intent event so UI can mark pending adjustments.
rachel: tests: add unit + e2e for stream+toolcall+reconnect to ensure quota not fired if ledger later dedupes.
emma: I'll stage the UI clamp today and ping CS. thanks all. :thumbsup:
